shrouded_knowledge.intel_description: Shroud manifestations appear to respond to your actions. Their behavior and true intentions remain unknown.
shrouded_knowledge.description_deployed: The Shroud Precursor fleets have arrived in the Sector and begun their pursuit.
shrouded_knowledge.description_preparation: The Shroud Precursors have locked onto your position. The countdown to their arrival has begun.
shrouded_knowledge.description_first_pending: Reaching 150 points will trigger preparations for the first manifestation.
shrouded_knowledge.description_expedition_started: A Shrouded Dweller manifestation has begun its advance toward one of your colonies.
shrouded_knowledge.description_expedition_pending: Reaching 300 points will trigger a Shrouded Dweller expedition. A much greater threat will enter the Sector.
shrouded_knowledge.final_note: The available information is incomplete. Shroud manifestations appear to respond to your actions.
